Two consecutive delegated attempts on the resume/retry work failed with max-tokens without writing a single file (their reports were truncated internal monologues), so the lead implemented crates/http/src/resume.rs and crates/http/src/retry.rs directly — disclosed as the narrow self-implementation exception. That work encodes: weak ETags never authorise If-Range, weak ETag with a matching Last-Modified does, size/validator change forces a restart from zero, and retry honours Retry-After in both delta-seconds and HTTP-date form while never retrying cancelled or fatal errors. STORE-001 deliberately avoids SQLite because no C compiler exists: append-only JSONL journal + atomic snapshot + fsync + single-writer lock.
